content.heading: A tale of two passions — art and technology
text: Growing up, I had a lot of exposure to art and technology that was constantly changing. I enjoyed building with Lego, folding origami, and designing all sorts of things. At the same time, I was also fascinated with how websites worked and had several opportunities to develop websites for myself as well as for others.

Today, as a software engineer, I get to integrate my passion in art and design into software development. That is, I get to put on my artist cap when designing user interfaces and experiences, then use the latest technologies to develop them. In essence, being a software engineer allows me to apply art and design into building applications that bring positivity to people around the world.
